allProxy.description: Optional catch-all proxy (ALL_PROXY), for example socks5://127.0.0.1:1080. Agent CLIs may use this when HTTP/HTTPS proxies are unset.

proxy.credentialsNote: Proxy URLs are stored as plain text in app settings and are passed to Agent subprocesses. Avoid embedding credentials you would not want a spawned CLI to read.

httpProxy.description: HTTP proxy URL. Example: http://127.0.0.1:7890 or http://user:pass@host:port.
httpProxy.title: HTTP proxy

httpsProxy.description: HTTPS proxy URL. Leave empty to reuse the HTTP proxy.

proxy.manualIncomplete: Manual mode is selected but no proxy address is set, so traffic still goes direct.

noProxy.description: Comma-separated hosts that bypass the proxy. Localhost is recommended so app IPC stays direct.
noProxy.title: Bypass list (NO_PROXY)

proxy.notesBody: Applies to Agent subprocesses (including ACP), app and daemon model/API requests, and Chromium network traffic. Does not change your system proxy or force the integrated terminal to use these settings. Restart an active agent session after changing proxy settings so the new environment is picked up.
proxy.scopeDescription: Used for Agents and app outbound network requests. Does not hijack the system proxy or the integrated terminal by default.

status.label: Proxy status
status.offDetail: Outbound traffic is direct; no app proxy is applied.

test.description: Sends one request to ipinfo.io through the app's outbound path and reports the egress address, so you can tell whether the proxy is really in use.
